title: Signal Orchestration: unified failure signatures, tracehook enrichment, and multi-axis dashboard
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Create a composable pipeline that compiles raw traces, metrics and logs into a compact set of failure signatures and expose them via a multi-axis dashboard. The taxonomy will cover: timeouts (connect/read/kv-cache), overload (queueing/backpressure/burst-throttling), model execution errors (OOM, NaN, invalid logits), model-quality failures (hallucination/regression flagged by eval hooks), transport errors (HTTP 4xx/5xx, gRPC codes like UNAVAILABLE/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED/DEADLINE_EXCEEDED), and infrastructure anomalies (disk, GPU ECC, driver panics). Success criteria: 1) failure signatures reduce triage time by 40% on post-mortem samples; 2) dashboards surface top-3 root causes for 80% of incidents within 3 minutes of detection; 3) tracehook enrichment achieves <5ms p95 overhead per request. Non-goals: replace existing incident tooling or SLO definitions. Design principles: deterministic mapping (rule-driven) with ML-assisted clustering for long-tail; annotate signatures with likely mitigation playbook; ensure compatibility across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments.
workplan: 1) Taxonomy draft and canonical event definitions (2 sprints). 2) Implement tracehook enrichment library (Go) to attach minimal failure context and sampling IDs. 3) Metrics/log transform (FluentBit/Vector) to normalize error codes and surface 'failure_code' field. 4) Signature compiler service (stateless, k8s) that ingests normalized streams and emits top signatures and evidence traces. 5) Dashboard: multi-axis pivot — time vs failure_type vs customer-slice; runbooks linked. 6) Canary rollout (start with internal canary tenants, then Beta customers). 7) Post-deploy evaluation and automation for alerting and auto-linked PRs.
implementation_notes: Tracehook: provide SDKs for Rust/Go/Python runtimes; sample rate controls and lightweight KV cache context. Use OpenTelemetry span attributes for semantic mapping. Metrics pipeline: add transform to coalesce HTTP/gRPC codes and map to taxonomy. Signature compiler: use vectorized summarization every 60s, persist to Redis for short-term query and BigQuery for analytics. Dashboard: Grafana with backend plugin to retrieve compiled signatures and evidence traces. Security: ensure PII redaction in trace enrichment step and follow KMS encryption for persisted evidence.
